reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: This is a spec compliance issue, not a vulnerability. The spec (SG-011) mandates that BlobsByRange MUST be deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS, returning empty responses or rejecting requests. However, Phase 03's claim contains a critical flaw: FULU_FORK_EPOCH is set to max uint64 (18446744073709551615) on mainnet, meaning Fulu is not scheduled yet. The deprecation condition 'current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS' will never trigger until Fulu activates. The code at protocol.rs:396-401 conditionally adds BlobsByRange to supported_protocols only if Deneb fork exists, with no removal logic for post-Fulu. The handler at rpc_methods.rs:992-1101 validates data availability boundary but has no epoch-based deprecation check. While this IS a missing implementation of the spec requirement, it is NOT exploitable on current mainnet (Fulu not scheduled). The 'attack scenario' (dual serving obligations, resource exhaustion) cannot occur until Fulu activates AND the deprecation window passes, making this a future upgrade issue, which is explicitly out-of-scope per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE (conditional_scope.future_upgrades). Verdict: spec-compliant for current deployment state; implementation gap exists but not exploitable.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P Interface SG-011 (blob_sidecars_by_range_deprecated): INV-001 requires full deprecation after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. Spec mandates respond_empty_or_reject after this boundary.
